prompts.display_text: Pin a country that Saints names as having a Church Family Services agency in the 2000s.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 4 ch. 35: LDS Family Services ran agencies in only these countries in the 2000s. Pin one.
prompts.summary: In the 2000s LDS Family Services ran agencies in only six countries: the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Great Britain and Japan. Japan was the only Asian country on the list.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Home base of the agency.

answers.name: Canada
answers.fact: One of six countries with agencies.

answers.name: Australia
answers.fact: One of six countries with agencies.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: Listed as Great Britain.

answers.name: New Zealand
answers.fact: One of six countries with agencies.

answers.name: Japan
answers.fact: The only Asian country with an agency.

prompts.display_text: Pin a European country where a current General Authority Seventy was born (as of October 2026).
prompts.text_original: As of October 2026, several General Authority Seventies were born in Europe. Pin a European country where a current General Authority Seventy was born, according to the Church's official biographies.
prompts.citation: Church leader biographies, General Authority Seventies, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: As of October 2026, six European countries are birthplaces of current General Authority Seventies: the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, France, the Netherlands and Portugal. Elder Massimo De Feo of Taranto, Italy, and Elder Hans T. Boom of Amsterdam are among them.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: Elders Jorg Klebingat (Zweibrucken) and Michael Cziesla (Neumunster).

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: Elders Alan T. Phillips (Kent, England) and Karl D. Hirst (Bury, Lancashire).

answers.name: France
answers.fact: Elder Christophe G. Giraud-Carrier, born in Lyon.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: Elder Massimo De Feo, born in Taranto.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: Elder Hans T. Boom, born in Amsterdam.

answers.name: Portugal
answers.fact: Elder Jose Teixeira, born in Vila Real.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding a place named in the Song of Solomon, from Engedi to Lebanon (leave out Tirzah and Kedar)
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place named in the Song of Solomon: Lebanon and the tops of Amana, Shenir and Hermon, the tower of Lebanon toward Damascus, Engedi, Carmel and Sharon, Heshbon and Gilead, or Pharaoh's chariots (Tirzah and the tents of Kedar are left out: their sites are not fixed in Church sources)
prompts.note: Mount Hermon (Shenir) sits on the Lebanon-Syria border, so both count. Jerusalem is scored as Israel.
prompts.summary: The Song of Solomon draws its imagery from the whole land: the vineyards of Engedi, the rose of Sharon, the cedars of Lebanon, the heights of Hermon, the pools of Heshbon and the goats of Gilead. It also borrows Pharaoh's chariots (Song 1-7).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Camphire in the vineyards of Engedi, the rose of Sharon, and a head like Carmel (Song 1:14; 2:1; 7:5).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Come with me from Lebanon; the tower of Lebanon looks toward Damascus (Song 4:8; 7:4).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: She is likened to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots (Song 1:9).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Her eyes are like the fishpools in Heshbon, and her hair as a flock of goats from mount Gilead (Song 4:1; 7:4).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: The tower of Lebanon looketh toward Damascus, and the bride is called from the top of Shenir and Hermon (Song 4:8; 7:4).

prompts.display_text: Pin a country holding a place in Josiah's reforms, his death at Megiddo, or Pharaoh Necho's march
prompts.text_original: A present-day country holding a place or kingdom named in Josiah's reforms and death and their aftermath (2 Kings 23; 2 Chronicles 35:20-36:4): the high places of the gods of Zidon, Moab and Ammon, Bethel and Samaria's high places, Megiddo, Necho's march against the king of Assyria toward Carchemish by Euphrates, Riblah in Hamath, and Egypt
prompts.note: Bethel and Samaria are in the West Bank (Palestine); Megiddo is in Israel.
prompts.summary: King Josiah of Judah purged idolatry from Jerusalem to Bethel and the cities of Samaria. When Pharaoh Necho marched north toward Carchemish to aid the king of Assyria, Josiah met him at Megiddo and was slain. Necho then bound Josiah's son Jehoahaz at Riblah and carried him to Egypt (2 Kgs 23; 2 Chr 35).

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt came up, and he carried Jehoahaz to Egypt, where he died (2 Kgs 23:29, 34).

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Josiah went against Necho and was slain at Megiddo (2 Kgs 23:29; 2 Chr 35:22-24).

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: Josiah broke down the altar at Bethel and the high places in the cities of Samaria (2 Kgs 23:15, 19).

answers.name: Jordan
answers.fact: Josiah defiled the high places Solomon had built for Chemosh of the Moabites and Milcom of the children of Ammon (2 Kgs 23:13).

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: Necho put Jehoahaz in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath (2 Kgs 23:33).

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: He also defiled the high place Solomon built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians (2 Kgs 23:13).

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: Necho came to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates (2 Chr 35:20); the ruins of Carchemish lie at Turkey's border with Syria; Church Bible Maps 5, 6 and 9 plot Carchemish on the upper Euphrates.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Latin American or Caribbean country or territory where a current General Authority Seventy was born (October 2026).
prompts.text_original: As of October 2026, several General Authority Seventies were born in Latin America or the Caribbean. Pin a country or territory in that region where a current General Authority Seventy was born, according to the Church's official biographies.
prompts.citation: Church leader biographies, General Authority Seventies, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.note: Elder Perkins was born in Colorado and Elder Valenzuela in Mexico, so neither adds a country.
prompts.summary: The Church's General Authority Seventies come from many nations. As of October 2026 their official biographies list birthplaces across Latin America and the Caribbean, from Brazil and Mexico to Jamaica, Venezuela and Puerto Rico. Brazil, Mexico, Argentina and Chile each have several.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: Elders Aidukaitis, Godoy, Silva, Farias and others were born in Brazil.

answers.name: Mexico
answers.fact: Elders Alonso (Mexico City), Casillas (Tijuana), Villanueva (Oaxaca), Roman (Iguala).

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: Elders Walker and Alliaud (Buenos Aires), Ortega, Costa.

answers.name: Chile
answers.fact: Elders Giuffra and Villar (Valparaiso), Gimenez (Antofagasta), Vargas (Puerto Varas).

answers.name: Guatemala
answers.fact: Elder Valeri V. Cordon, born in Guatemala City.

answers.name: Peru
answers.fact: Elder Taylor G. Godoy, born in Lima.

answers.name: Colombia
answers.fact: Elder Mathias Held, born in Bogota.

answers.name: Puerto Rico
answers.fact: Elders Hugo E. Martinez (Mayaguez) and Jorge M. Alvarado (Ponce).

answers.name: Venezuela
answers.fact: Elder Pedro X. Larreal, born in Valencia.

answers.name: Jamaica
answers.fact: Elder Kevin G. Brown, born in Manchester, Jamaica.
